entries.label: Individual instalment trigger (net tax owing)
entries.notes: Must exceed the threshold in the current year AND in either of the two preceding years.
entries.source_note: CRA 'Who has to pay - Required tax instalments for individuals' (fetched 2026-09-29).

entries.label: Net tax owing definition (instalment test base)
entries.notes: CPP contributions payable (line 42100) and EI premiums payable (line 42120) are NOT part of net tax owing but ARE added to the total instalment amount due once required.
entries.source_note: CRA 'Calculation chart for instalment payments' 2020/2021 PDFs (official); 2026 chart follows the identical form. Corroborated by MoneySense 2026-09-29.
entries.value: Total income tax payable (net federal tax line 42000 + social benefits repayment 42200 + provincial tax 42800) minus tax deducted at source (43700) minus refundable credits

entries.label: Individual instalment due dates
entries.notes: Shift to the next business day if a date falls on a weekend/holiday. In 2026, Mar 15 was a Sunday, so the Q1 deadline fell on Mon Mar 16.
entries.source_note: CRA 'Required tax instalments for individuals' main page (crawled ~2026-09-26); weekday check via date(1) 2026-09-29.

entries.label: Farmers/fishers instalment rule
entries.notes: Main-source-of-income test. Single annual instalment = 66% (two-thirds) of the total instalment amount due, payable by Dec 31.
entries.source_note: CRA main instalments page + 2020/2021 calculation charts (official); thecanadianwire Sep 2026 corroborates.

entries.label: Instalment reminder schedule (form INNS1)
entries.notes: Reminders also visible in CRA My Account. If estimated net tax owing for the year is at/below the threshold, reminders may be disregarded.

entries.label: 2026 prescribed interest rate on overdue/instalment tax
entries.notes: Announced by CRA Aug 28, 2026. Unchanged for six straight quarters (Q3 2025 through Q4 2026). Compounded daily on late/insufficient instalment payments; can change quarterly.
entries.source_note: Advisor.ca Q4 2026 announcement + KMSS prescribed-rates table (Jul 2025-Sep 2026); Investment Executive corroboration (fetched 2026-09-29).

entries.label: Instalment penalty rule (individuals)
entries.notes: Penalty = (instalment interest minus the greater of $1,000 or 25% of interest-if-no-payments) divided by 2.
entries.source_note: CRA 'Interest and penalty charges - Required tax instalments for individuals' (fetched 2026-09-29).
entries.value: Applies only if the year's instalment interest exceeds $1,000

entries.label: Instalment credit interest (early/overpaid instalments)
entries.notes: Credit interest is computed on early/extra payments; it only offsets instalment interest in the same tax year and is never refunded.
entries.value: Overpaying the next instalment or paying early earns instalment credit interest, usable only against same-year instalment interest charges

entries.label: Three instalment calculation options
entries.notes: No-calculation = safe harbour (full reminder amount paid on time blocks instalment interest even if actual tax is higher). Prior-year/current-year = no interest or penalty if payments cover the requirement, unless estimates too low.
entries.source_note: CRA 'Options to calculate' page (fetched 2026-09-29). Safe-harbour mechanics corroborated by t3mconsulting + Yahoo syndicated explainer (secondary).

value.current_year: Quarter of estimated current-year net tax owing + CPP payable + voluntary EI premiums
value.no_calculation: Pay the amount on the instalment reminder; CRA-computed from latest assessed return
value.prior_year: Quarter of prior-year net tax owing + CPP payable + voluntary EI premiums

entries.label: Q4 2026 refund interest rate (non-corporate overpayments)
entries.notes: Rate the CRA pays when it owes the taxpayer. Relevant to the 'do not overpay instalments to earn interest' trap.

entries.label: Eliminating instalments via increased withholding
entries.notes: TD1 for employer/pension withholding; ISP3520OAS for OAS, ISP3520CPP for CPP benefits. Income tax cannot be withheld from self-employment, investment, rental, or capital-gains income.
entries.source_note: CRA 'Options to calculate' page, Hugh example (fetched 2026-09-29).
entries.value: Increase tax withheld at source so estimated net tax owing stays at or under $3,000 ($1,800 QC); then disregard the instalment reminders
